migration.title: Import your Kilter or Tension logbook
migration.description: Link your Kilter or Tension account to bring your sends to Boardsesh, or import an export from the old Kilter app.

migration.title: Bring your logbook to Boardsesh
migration.lead: Your Kilter and Tension sends can come with you. Pick the route that matches where your history lives.

account.title: You have a Kilter or Tension account
account.step1: Get the free app and sign in.
account.step2: Tap your avatar, then Settings, then Connected apps.
account.step3: Tap Sign in to Kilter, or Link on the Tension card.
account.sync: After you link your account, Boardsesh checks for new sends in the background. Timing varies. Imports run one way into Boardsesh; nothing you log here goes back to their apps.

legacy.title: You used the old Kilter app (Aurora)
legacy.export: You get one file with your ascents, attempts and circuits.
legacy.signIn: Sign in to Boardsesh on your phone
legacy.uploadInstructions: In Connected apps, open the Kilter (Aurora) card and choose your export.

history.title: Why this page exists
history.body: In March 2026, the old Kilter app stopped working. Climbers who hadn’t exported their history lost access to it in the app.
